hints: The centre of $C_1$ is $A(1, 2)$ and point of contact is $B(5, 5)$.
The reflection of $A$ across the tangent line at $B$ lies on the normal line with $B$ as the midpoint of $AC_2$.
walkthrough:
The tangent is perpendicular to the radius, so contact is the midpoint of the reflected centres.
Since $4x + 3y = 35$ is tangent to $C_1$ at $B(5, 5)$, reflecting $C_1$ across this line means the contact point $B$ is the midpoint of the centres $A(1, 2)$ and $C_2(x_2, y_2)$:
$$\vec{AB} = \begin{pmatrix} 5 - 1 \\ 5 - 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 4 \\ 3 \end{pmatrix}$$

Calculate the coordinates of the reflected centre $C_2$:
$$C_2 = B + \vec{AB} = (5 + 4, 5 + 3) = (9, 8)$$

hints: Reflection is an isometry, so the radius is preserved ($r = 5, r^2 = 25$).
Use centre $(9, 8)$ to write the equation: $(x - 9)^2 + (y - 8)^2 = 25$.
walkthrough:
The tangent is perpendicular to the radius, so contact is the midpoint of the reflected centres.
Reflection is an isometry, so the radius is preserved:
$$r = 5 \implies r^2 = 25$$

Write the standard form equation using centre $(9, 8)$:
$$(x - 9)^2 + (y - 8)^2 = 25$$
